description: This file defines the EmployeeGender class, which is part of a reporting filter system for a Human Resource Management (HRM) application. It handles filtering employee records based on gender and provides methods for query modification and data representation.

classes.name: EmployeeGender
classes.description: A filter field class for filtering employee records by gender in reports.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a gender-based filter condition to the query builder when the operator is EQUAL and the value is not null.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the relevant entity aliases used in query filtering, in this case, ['employee'].

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Provides a simple array representing the gender value, translating '1' to 'Male' and others to 'Female'.
